Associate Software Developer

Cedar Rapids, IA
Description

  

Associate Software Developer

BUSINESS UNIT: CCR Media

FUNCTION: Service

REPORTS TO: Manager of Development

CLASSIFICATION: Exempt

LOCATION: Cedar Rapids, IA

EDUCATION: Bachelor’s or Associate’s degree in a computer related field preferred, or equivalent relevant experience

EXPERIENCE: 0 to 2 years of experience preferred

Who We Are Looking For

CCR Media is the engine behind modern media. We build cutting-edge technology that captures and connects streaming and broadcast content across thousands of channels worldwide. Our platforms power the world’s leading media measurement, analytics, and technology companies by delivering real-time data, global scale, and the infrastructure required to innovate in today’s streaming-first ecosystem.  Our clients are some of the largest Media Measurement, Media Analytics, and Consumer Electronics companies in the world. 

We are looking for an Associate Software Developer who is eager to learn, thrives in an innovative and agile environment, and enjoys working collaboratively across teams. In this entry level role, you will help design, develop, test, and deploy software applications that solve key business problems, working alongside and learning from senior developers. You will support specific software suites within our custom software portfolio and contribute to internal projects that advance our development function, all while building your technical skills.

What You’ll Accomplish and Experience

Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from design and development to testing and deployment, with guidance from senior developers
Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code for new features and enhancements
Help build data sources, APIs, and front end components for web applications
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve software issues submitted through tickets
Write and run unit tests to ensure software quality
Participate in code reviews and apply feedback to grow your technical skills
Collaborate with designers, developers, and cross functional teams to deliver quality solutions
Create and maintain technical documentation for your work
Learn to apply security, performance, usability, and reliability best practices in your development work
Build strong relationships with customers by making their needs a primary focus

Desirable Previous Experience

Bachelor’s or Associate’s degree in a computer related field, or equivalent relevant experience
Foundational knowledge of one or more programming languages and frameworks such as Python, SQL, .NET/C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Vue, and HTML/CSS
Basic understanding of data structures, algorithms, and object oriented programming
Familiarity with relational (SQL) and NoSQL databases such as MongoDB
Exposure to Git or other version control systems
Understanding of web application fundamentals, including APIs and client and server architecture
Familiarity with AI assisted development tools and effective prompting, with an understanding that AI generated code must be reviewed and validated
Academic, internship, or personal project experience building software applications
Strong problem solving skills, a coachable attitude, and an eagerness to learn new technologies

Why CCR Media

At CCR Technologies, the parent company of CCR Media, you are not just joining a company, you are becoming a part of a team that has been delivering innovative technology solutions for nearly four decades. We’re a nationally recognized, award-winning organization committed to excellence, growth, and creating an environment where people love to work. As an eleven-year Great Place to Work® certified employer, we take pride in fostering a culture grounded in our values of:

Pursue Human Excellence
Partner to Win
Create Value, Own the Outcome
Lead with Curiosity and Courage

CCR offers a truly unique work-life balance with competitive benefits designed to support your personal and professional well-being. From free daily lunch for onsite team members in Cedar Rapids, to comprehensive health benefits, gym membership reimbursement, 401(k), paid time off, and ongoing development opportunities, you’ll have the support you need to thrive.

At CCR, you’ll join a high-growth, high-performance organization that values driven, adaptable individuals who want to make an impact in an innovative and agile environment. It’s a place where you can truly build your future.

Want to see more about our story, follow the link https://ccr.net/the-ccr-story/
